title: Matrix Computations (4th Edition)
authors: Gene H. Golub, Charles F. Van Loan
annotation: The authoritative reference on numerical linear algebra, Singular Value Decomposition algorithms, condition numbers, and least-squares perturbation bounds.

title: Convex Optimization
annotation: Foundational text covering Lagrange duality, Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality conditions, and second-order interior-point algorithms.

title: Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision (2nd Edition)
annotation: Essential reference on projective geometry, SVD algebraic solvers for the 8-point algorithm, Sampson error, and Bundle Adjustment optimization.

title: State Estimation for Robotics
annotation: Rigorous treatment of Lie groups SO(3) and SE(3), matrix exponentials, and continuous-discrete Gaussian filtering for spatial estimation.
